item.title: Rust for .NET developers [Spanish]
item.description: In this session, we will explore how .NET developers can transition into the Rust ecosystem. We’ll examine the core differences and similarities between C# and the Microsoft stack. By contrasting familiar .NET patterns with Rust-specific concepts—such as ownership, the borrow checker, and memory safety.

item.title: Creating an authorizer in AWS with cargo-lambda [Spanish]
item.description: In this session, we will explore how to leverage cargo-lambda to develop and deploy custom AWS Authorizers. The authorizer is used as an example to show how easy and performant is to use AWS lambdas with Rust.

item.title: Rust workshop: Build your own ls command [Spanish]
item.description: Presentation of the self-guided workshop by oxidar.org. The workshop is designed to be interactive: to pass each stage, the user must create a pull request against the main branch. Test are automatically run in a GitHub actions pipeline and if all tests are successful, the user is allowed to work on the next stage.
